chunks.english: What do you do when you are angry, Aiwen?
chunks.translation: 艾文，你生气的时候会怎么做？

chunks.english: What if you are very angry?
Well, I usually go for a walk instead.
I know how you feel, but that can hurt others.
chunks.translation: 我理解你的感受，但那样可能会伤害别人。

chunks.english: Maybe I'll try going for a walk too next time.
chunks.translation: 也许下次我也会试着去散步。

chunks.english: Did you see that boy from another class?
chunks.translation: 你看到那个别班的男孩了吗？

chunks.english: He kept making fun of me.
I really wanted to shout bad words at him!
Yafei, you can do better than that!
chunks.translation: 亚飞，你可以做得比那更好！

chunks.english: Did you try taking a deep breath?
I did, but it's not working.
Come on, let's go for a walk.

chunks.translation: 卢卡斯，你能别这样了吗？

chunks.english: Let's calm down and talk it out.
chunks.translation: 我们冷静下来，把话说开吧。

chunks.english: You shouted bad words at me!
You made fun of my haircut.
Now, everyone is laughing at me.
Lucas, you need to say sorry to me.
chunks.translation: 卢卡斯，你需要向我道歉。

chunks.english: Lucas, can we stop fighting and talk it out?
chunks.translation: 卢卡斯，我们能不能别吵了，把话说开？

chunks.english: I just don't understand why you got so angry.
chunks.translation: 我只是不明白你为什么这么生气。

chunks.english: I felt so bad when you yelled at me.
chunks.translation: 你对我大喊的时候，我感觉很难受。

chunks.english: But I felt hurt when you made fun of my haircut and called me names.
chunks.translation: 但你取笑我的发型、骂我的时候，我觉得受伤了。

chunks.english: And I felt even worse because everyone laughed at me.
chunks.translation: 而且因为大家都笑我，我感觉更糟了。

chunks.english: I understand you didn't mean to hurt me, but you did.
chunks.translation: 我知道你不是故意伤害我，但你的确伤害了我。

chunks.english: I'm sorry about shouting bad words at you and calling you names, too.
chunks.translation: 我也为对你说脏话、骂你而道歉。

chunks.english: You were right to feel angry.
Let's put this behind us, all right?
chunks.translation: 我们把这件事放下，好吗？

chunks.english: Dad, can I talk to you?
You may fall behind in school.
But it will help me grow stronger.
chunks.translation: 但它会帮助我变得更强壮。

chunks.english: Maybe I can try for a month first?
chunks.translation: 也许我可以先试一个月？

chunks.english: I want to join the rock-climbing club at our school.
chunks.translation: 我想加入学校的攀岩社团。

chunks.english: But I'm worried my parents won't let me.
chunks.translation: 但我担心父母不会让我参加。

chunks.english: They may worry about me getting hurt.
chunks.translation: 他们可能担心我会受伤。

chunks.english: Maybe you can listen to their worries first, and then come up with an idea together.
chunks.translation: 也许你可以先听听他们的担心，然后一起想办法。

chunks.english: Alice's dad just got back home from work.
chunks.translation: 爱丽丝的爸爸刚下班回家。

chunks.english: Hey, Dad, there's a club I ...
Can we talk about it later?
I'm a little tired right now.
After dinner, in the living room, Alice comes in with a cup of tea.
chunks.translation: 晚饭后，在客厅里，爱丽丝端着一杯茶进来了。

chunks.english: Dad, do you have a minute?
I'd like to join a rock-climbing club.
chunks.translation: 我想加入一个攀岩社团。

chunks.english: That sounds exciting, but also dangerous.
chunks.translation: 听起来很刺激，但也很危险。

chunks.english: Can you join when you're older?
chunks.translation: 你能长大一点再参加吗？

chunks.english: But we have coaches to keep us safe.
chunks.translation: 但我们有教练保护我们的安全。

chunks.english: Do you know how often they train?
chunks.translation: 你知道他们多久训练一次吗？

chunks.english: They train three times a week.
And they have free practise every Sunday.
chunks.translation: 而且每个星期天都有自由练习。

chunks.english: I can go twice a week!
Nikki, what's it like to have a cat?

chunks.translation: 我的猫到哪儿都跟着我。

chunks.english: I thought cats liked to be alone.
I also heard cats sleep during the day and play at night.
chunks.translation: 我还听说猫白天睡觉，晚上玩耍。

chunks.english: Well, my cat does sleep a lot during the day.
chunks.translation: 嗯，我的猫白天确实睡很多。

chunks.english: But she wakes up to play with me when I get home from school.
chunks.translation: 但我放学回家时，她会醒来和我玩。

chunks.english: First, you need to think about space.
Cats stay inside most of the time.
chunks.translation: 猫大部分时间待在室内。

chunks.english: However, dogs need to go for a walk at least twice a day.
chunks.translation: 然而，狗每天至少需要出门散步两次。

chunks.english: Next, dogs and cats have different habits.
chunks.translation: 其次，狗和猫有不同的习惯。

chunks.english: Most cats like to sleep during the day and play during the night.
chunks.translation: 大多数猫喜欢白天睡觉、夜间玩耍。

chunks.english: If you are a light sleeper, think twice before getting a cat.
chunks.translation: 如果你睡觉很容易醒，养猫前要三思。

chunks.english: You need to clean dogs often.
Unlike dogs, cats usually clean themselves.
chunks.translation: 不像狗，猫通常会自己清洁自己。

chunks.english: They both love playing with toys.
Finally, make sure your family is OK with the idea, too!
chunks.translation: 最后，也要确保你的家人同意这个想法！

chunks.english: Get an animal everyone will like!
chunks.translation: 选择一种大家都会喜欢的动物！

chunks.english: Yafei, my aunt just gave me 300 yuan to get myself a gift!
chunks.translation: 亚飞，我阿姨刚给了我三百元，让我给自己买一份礼物！

chunks.english: What do you plan to get?
I want to buy a bike.
Well, you may want to buy something, but it doesn't mean you really need it.
chunks.translation: 嗯，你可能想买某样东西，但这并不意味着你真的需要它。

chunks.english: Maybe you can try it out first and think about it more.
chunks.translation: 也许你可以先试一试，再多想一想。

chunks.english: First, think about it: Do I need that thing or do I just want it?
chunks.translation: 首先，想一想：我需要那样东西，还是我只是想要它？

chunks.english: If you're not sure, wait a few days.
chunks.translation: 如果你不确定，就等几天。

chunks.english: Next, ask yourself: Do I need that thing right now?
chunks.translation: 接着，问问自己：我现在就需要那样东西吗？

chunks.english: If not, you can buy it later.
chunks.translation: 如果不需要，你可以以后再买。

chunks.english: Keep an eye out for sales, or try second-hand shops.
chunks.translation: 留意促销，或者试试二手商店。

chunks.english: After you make up your mind, try to learn more about it.
chunks.translation: 下定决心后，试着多了解它。

chunks.english: Go online, ask others about it, or give it a try.
chunks.translation: 上网查一查，问问别人，或者试用一下。

chunks.english: Ask yourself: Is it the best deal?
chunks.translation: 问问自己：这是最划算的选择吗？

chunks.english: Sometimes "buy one get one free" may not be the better deal.
chunks.translation: 有时候“买一送一”不一定更划算。

chunks.english: Check the "best before date" or BBD for short.
chunks.translation: 检查“最佳食用日期”，简称 BBD。

chunks.english: Vegetables are good for your health.
chunks.translation: 蔬菜对你的健康有好处。

chunks.english: Food waste is a big problem at our school.
chunks.translation: 食物浪费是我们学校的一个大问题。

chunks.english: Sometimes the canteen staff give too much food to students.
chunks.translation: 有时候食堂工作人员给学生太多食物。

chunks.english: Also, some students are picky about food.
Do you know what happens to our leftovers?
chunks.translation: 你知道我们的剩饭剩菜会怎样吗？

chunks.english: The staff usually throw it away at the end of the day.
chunks.translation: 工作人员通常在一天结束时把它们扔掉。

chunks.english: We've got to do something about this!
chunks.translation: 我们必须为这件事做点什么！

chunks.english: There are thirty students in our class.
Seven said that they usually don't have enough time for breakfast.
chunks.translation: 七名学生说他们通常没有足够时间吃早餐。

chunks.english: So, they feel hungry at noon, and they end up taking too much food.
chunks.translation: 所以他们中午会觉得饿，最后拿了太多食物。

chunks.english: Three students said that sometimes the canteen staff give them too much food.
chunks.translation: 三名学生说有时候食堂工作人员给他们太多食物。

chunks.english: Ten students said that they don't like some of the food.
chunks.translation: 十名学生说他们不喜欢某些食物。

chunks.english: Six students said that they want to chat or play during lunch break.
chunks.translation: 六名学生说他们午休时想聊天或玩耍。

chunks.english: They usually eat very little and then rush out to meet their friends.
chunks.translation: 他们通常吃得很少，然后急着跑出去找朋友。

chunks.english: Lastly, four students said they like to bring snacks to school.
chunks.translation: 最后，四名学生说他们喜欢带零食到学校。

chunks.english: When it is time for lunch, they don't feel hungry at all.
chunks.translation: 到了午餐时间，他们一点也不饿。

chunks.english: don't play if you are hurt
chunks.translation: 如果受伤了就不要参加运动

chunks.english: watch out for others on the playground
The game starts in five minutes.
You shouldn't play when you are hungry!
chunks.translation: 你饿着肚子时不应该比赛！

chunks.english: No, but I think I'll be okay.
chunks.translation: 没有，但我想我会没事的。

chunks.english: You're not even wearing the right shoes, and it's raining!
chunks.translation: 你甚至没穿合适的鞋，而且还在下雨！

chunks.english: I had a bad day yesterday.
In the morning, I had an important football game, but I overslept!
chunks.translation: 早上，我有一场重要的足球比赛，但我睡过头了！

chunks.english: I ran out of the house without having breakfast.
chunks.translation: 我没吃早餐就跑出了家门。

chunks.english: When I arrived at school, I had no time to warm up.
chunks.translation: 当我到学校时，我没有时间热身。

chunks.english: I even wore the wrong shoes!

chunks.translation: 更糟的是，当时还在下雨！

chunks.english: I am sure you can guess what happened next.
chunks.translation: 我相信你能猜到接下来发生了什么。

chunks.english: I didn't watch out for others on the playground, got pushed, and fell ...
chunks.translation: 我在操场上没有注意其他人，被推了一下，然后摔倒了……

chunks.english: And I hurt my right foot again!
chunks.translation: 而且我的右脚又受伤了！
亚飞的妈妈当时在那里。

chunks.english: I did learn a lesson yesterday: Always get ready before sports, and be careful when you play.
chunks.translation: 昨天我确实吸取了一个教训：运动前一定要做好准备，运动时要小心。

chunks.english: Hey, guys, what do you think is a good gift?
chunks.translation: 嘿，大家觉得什么礼物好？

chunks.english: I want to get my grandpa something for his birthday.
chunks.translation: 我想给爷爷买一份生日礼物。

chunks.english: Well, first of all, I think it needs to carry meaning.
chunks.translation: 嗯，首先，我认为它需要有意义。

chunks.english: It doesn't have to be big or cost a lot.
chunks.translation: 它不一定要很大，也不一定要花很多钱。

chunks.english: I can't agree with you more!
Maybe get him something that shows your love.
chunks.translation: 也许可以买能表达你爱意的东西。

chunks.english: Or something to help him stay healthy.
chunks.translation: 或者买能帮助他保持健康的东西。

chunks.english: You can also get him something he really needs.
chunks.translation: 你也可以买他真正需要的东西。

chunks.english: You want to show your care for him and make his life better.
chunks.translation: 你想表达对他的关心，让他的生活更好。

chunks.english: This way, he knows you are always thinking of him.
chunks.translation: 这样，他就知道你一直想着他。
